text.en:
Creation - The Office of the Presidential Adviser for
Constitutional Reform (OPACR) is hereby created under the Office of the
President, to be headed by the Presidential Adviser for Constitutional Reform
(PACR), who shall have the rank and emoluments of a Cabinet Secretary.
Powers and Functions of the Office of the
Presidential Adviser for Constitutional Reform. - The PAC shall exercise
the following powers and functions:
Study and advise the President on matters and concerns relative to
changes in and reforms of the 1987 Constitution, including
fundamental changes in the political structure of the Government;
Conduct consultations and undertake liaisons with the public and
private sectors;
POMA Hologram * 24989

Recommend to the President policies, strategies, programs and
mechanisms conducive to the attainment of the necessary
fundamental changes and reforms; and
Submit periodic reports to the President and perform such other
functions as the President may direct.
Organizational Support. - The PACR shall be assisted by
a Deputy Presidential Adviser who shall have the rank of an Undersecretary and
two (2) Assistant Secretaries. The PACR is hereby authorized to formulate the
organizational structure of its office and engage the services of consultants as
may be necessary, consistent with existing laws.
Assistance. - The OPACR may call upon any agency of the
Government for such assistance as may be necessary in the performance of its
Funding. - Funding for the initial operations of the OPACR
shall be provided by the Office of the President. Succeeding appropriations shall
be included in the budget proposal for the Office of the President.
Repealing Clause. -.All orders, rules, regulations and
issuances, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
immediately upon approval.
Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect
DONE, in the City of Manila this 2nd day of March
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Four.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
